research_notes.logo: The awarding body is the University of Geneva. Its own pages embed exactly one institutional logo asset: https://www.unige.ch/cdn/themes/unige2016/img/unige-logo.svg (referenced in the header and footer of the Faculty of Science page, and again on the UNIGE homepage). I probed it: HTTP 200, content-type image/svg+xml, 13087 bytes (content-length), SVG root 163.7x47.2 viewBox. Rejected it as a hard ban: the only paint value in the entire file is fill="#FFFFFF", i.e. a white-on-transparent wordmark that would be invisible on a light card. I re-probed the own-domain apple-touch-icon on 2026-10-04 after the earlier attempt was hit by repeated 504 / transport timeouts, and this time it returned cleanly: HTTP 200, content-type image/png, content-length 9423 bytes. Pixel inspection of the 180x180 raster shows a near-white background carrying a magenta roundel with white lettering, i.e. a coloured mark that reads clearly on a light card, so it is reported as the official logo. The SVG wordmark stays rejected under the white-on-transparent ban, and the reported logo asset is the apple-touch-icon served from www.unige.ch.

new_scholarship.selection_notes: Around ten excellence scholarships are awarded each year. The SASME checks completeness, the Admissions Office (SII) decides formal eligibility, the faculty decides admission to the chosen master's, and finally the Selection Board for the Master's Scholarship selects the scholarship holders in March, with applicants notified in early April. Decisions may not be appealed.

new_scholarship.description: The University of Lausanne awards around ten excellence scholarships each year, exclusively to students who have graduated from a foreign university and whose academic results are of a very high standard. The scholarship is paid for the minimum statutory period of the Master's programme at CHF 1,600 per month, and recipients are exempt from the standard course registration fees, with only the CHF 80 semester fees remaining payable. UNIL states explicitly that the amount does not constitute full funding, since about CHF 2,000 per month is needed to live in Lausanne. Applications for the 2027/2028 academic year are open until 1 November 2026.

research_notes.logo: The awarding body is the University of Lausanne. Its own pages embed exactly one institutional logo asset, /modules/refonte-assets/images/unil-logo.svg, which resolves to https://www.unil.ch/modules/refonte-assets/images/unil-logo.svg. I fetched it successfully (HTTP 200, 1322-byte SVG markup, viewBox 0 0 659.7 223.6) but rejected it under the hard ban on white-on-transparent wordmarks: its single style class is '.st0 { fill: #fff; }' and every path in the UNIL-LOGOTYPE group uses class st0, so the whole wordmark is white. UNIL's own brand pages confirm a black variant exists but only inside download archives: https://www.unil.ch/unil/en/home/menuinst/universite/media-et-communication/identite-visuelle/espace-de-telechargement.html offers 'University of Lausanne (zip - EPS format)' and '(zip - PDF format)' and states 'This folder contains all the UNIL logos (white, black, blue)'. Those are ZIP archives of EPS/PDF vector files, not a directly servable image/png, image/svg+xml or image/jpeg asset, so they cannot be reported under the accepted content types. I probed four sibling dark-variant paths on the same host - unil-logo-black.svg, unil-logo-couleur.svg, logo-unil.svg and unil-logo-rouge.svg - and all four returned HTTP 404 with content-type text/html, i.e. they do not exist. On a re-probe on 2026-10-04, after the earlier attempts were hit by repeated 504 / transport timeouts, the own-domain brand icon returned cleanly: https://www.unil.ch/apple-touch-icon.png, HTTP 200, content-type image/png, content-length 4501 bytes. Pixel inspection of the 180x180 raster shows a solid UNIL brand-blue square (rgb 0,55,235, hex #0037EB, 29,344 of 32,400 sampled pixels) carrying white UNIL lettering. Because the lettering sits on a solid blue field rather than on transparency, it is not a white-on-transparent wordmark and reads clearly on a light card, so it is reported as the official logo. https://www.unil.ch/favicon.svg was also probed (HTTP 200, image/svg+xml, 77460 bytes) and its only paint is a full-bleed fill="#0037eb" rect over the same brand-blue mark; the apple-touch-icon PNG was preferred because it carries the wordmark legibly in raster form.

The programme pays a monthly net allowance of CHF 3,907 together with CERN health insurance, a possible family supplement, possible travel to Geneva on joining, and 30 days of paid leave plus two weeks of annual closure. Contracts run six months and are renewable up to three years, with the possibility of spreading the total over a maximum of four consecutive years. Eligibility is limited to nationals of CERN Member or Associate Member States, and applicants from Pakistan, Lithuania, Latvia, Cyprus, Croatia and Turkey are currently excluded because the Article II.5 ceiling has been reached.

The candidate must have started or be about to start a doctoral programme, the university must accept that the CERN research contributes to the doctoral thesis, and a good knowledge of English or French is required.
